services.name: Bike Trails
services.desc: Riding the backcountry and primitive roads of Glen Canyon National Recreation Area is a great way to enjoy the scenery of the Colorado Plateau. As more and more people turn to adventure biking as a means to reach these scenic areas, it’s important to keep in mind some safe and ethical riding practices. Warm Creek Road (#230): 13+ miles. A popular road from Big Water, Utah to various points. This road is rocky and very muddy when wet. Crosby Canyon Road (#231): 13 miles from Big Water to the lake. services.name: Horseshoe Bend
services.desc: Welcome to Horseshoe Bend, one of the most photographed spots in the country!Located just 6 miles south of Page, AZ, this natural marvel is a must-see. Horseshoe Bend is part of the mighty Colorado River, carving its way through Glen Canyon in a breathtaking 1,000-ft deep, horseshoe-shaped curve. Getting to the overlook is simple-just a 1.5-mile round-trip hike over mostly flat terrain. The trail is wide and accessible for low-impact walkers and wheelchairs, with shade stations along the way.
